h:
通过我的动画工作流程解锁动画的功能并释放 Flux Klein 9b 的真正潜力。它具有色彩调整和简单高档的特点，非常适合动漫。我在工作流程中添加了注释来帮助您。我强烈建议在这个工作流程中使用我的动漫 lora。我感谢任何尝试我的模型的人！迫不及待地想看看你带来了哪些创意图片。

在保存图像节点中，请将哈希值更改为本页面的新哈希值。您可以在本页右侧看到它。我已经添加了一些注释来帮助您。其将图像上传到正确的工作流程页面。使用AUTOV3 哈希。我很感激！

另外，您可以在图像保护程序节点中将我的版本 1 动漫 lora 的 AUTOV3 哈希更改为版本 2（我已经更新了 lora）。

此工作流程也适用于非动漫一代。只需禁用动漫 lora，选择采样器并生成逼真的图像。有时简单的工作流程就更好。无并发症。您也可以将分辨率提高到 1664x2432。我的 Lora 可以处理那么高分辨率。

o.en:
unlock the capability of anime and unleash flux klein 9b true potential with my anime workflow. It features color adjustments and a simple upscale, perfect for anime. I've included notes in the workflow to help you out. I strongly suggest using my anime lora with this workflow. I appreciate anyone who tries my models! Cant wait to see what creative images you bring.

In the save image node, please change the hash to the new hash from this page. you can see it on the right side of this page. I've included notes to help you with that. Its to upload image to the correct workflow page. Use theAUTOV3 hash. I appreciate it!

Also, you can change the AUTOV3 hash of my version 1 anime lora to version 2 (i've updated the lora) in the image saver node.

This workflow is also good for non anime generations. just disable the anime lora, choose your sampler and produce photorealistic images. Sometimes simple workflow equals better. no complications. You could increase the resolution as well to 1664x2432. My Lora can handle that high of resolution.
